description: The Markdown file editor preserves an unfinished comment before entering preview. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} runs in a directory holding draft.md, which reads "# Keep this note". "The comment dialog" is ".diff-viewer-comment-dialog". To "open F": press "p" (lowercase) with the Control modifier (on whatever has focus); wait for the finder input ".grp-filter" to be visible; fill it with F; wait for the FIRST ".grp-row" to contain F (assert_text_contains on ".grp-row", which checks the first match: the finder lists every file until the query applies, and Enter opens the top row, so waiting for any row with the text is not enough); press Enter in the finder input; the dialog (role "dialog") whose accessible name matches the regular expression /Edit .*F/ is then "the modal" for F, and its ".monaco-editor" should become visible (up to 15s). "The preview" is the modal's region (role "region") named "Markdown preview". "The editor input" is the modal's ".monaco-editor textarea.inputarea"; to focus it, eval its focus(). Key presses go to whatever has focus; do not click anything to focus first unless a step says so. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Open draft.md. 3. Click the modal's button named "Comment mode". 4. Click the modal's ".view-line" containing "Keep this note". 5. The comment dialog should be visible. 6. Fill its ".diff-viewer-comment-input" with "unfinished comment". 7. The modal's button named "Preview mode" should be disabled. 8. Press "p" (lowercase) with the modifiers Control+Alt. 9. The comment input should still have the value "unfinished comment". 10. The modal must hold exactly 0 regions named "Markdown preview".
